items.difficulty_reason: Devissage along an irreducible support: a 2-out-of-3 property P for coherent sheaves supported on Z_0 extends to all of them once a generator G with G_xi killed by m_xi and dim 1 exists - filtration bootstrapping handles supports strictly inside Z_0 via the filtration lemma and hypothesis (2); the prepare-filter-irreducible exact sequence forces r = 1 from (3)(c) and yields P for (Z_0 -> X)_*I; the intersection of any two ideals propagates P through two short exact sequences with strictly smaller support. Retained author proof at lines 3420-3484.
